FIRST review run on qa-fenced denominators: the 2026-07-14 review predates v4.18.0, which found that roughly 50 of its 60 "projects" were this project's own QA sandboxes posing as external field data, and fenced them out (AGENTSMD_TELEMETRY_TAG=qa going forward, classifyProject path-segment anchor for history). Re-running on the corrected denominators was the corrective action named by the 2026-07-25 audit. No verdict flipped, which is itself the finding: the fencing changed who counted as external, not which rules earn their residence.
